about_the_game:
The Season 7 Ultimate Battle Pass includes:

  • Season 7 Premium Battle Pass

  • 20 Battle Pass Levels*

  • 25% Match XP Boost

  • 1,000 Multibucks

  • Season 7 Ultimate Rewards in the Battle Pass

25% Match XP Boost will be applied to your Contestant for the duration of Season 7.

*Battle Pass Level skips will not apply beyond level 96 and will not unlock bonus pages. Any levels purchased after level 96 will be banked and automatically applied when the next season launches.

Multibucks is the premium currency of THE FINALS. You can use Multibucks to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, specific cosmetics like gun charms, pets and skins, or full bundles to really give your Contestant a unique look.

content_descriptors.notes: THE FINALS is the worlds greatest virtual combat entertainment game show, and as such features virtual violence. There's no gore or blood -- contestants turn into a pile of coins when eliminated.
